title: Post-evidence OTJ saving fixed
details: The existing post-evidence What did you learn flow now saves genuine learner-entered learning to the real OTJ record
The learner-entered learning duration is used and the task, job and KSB context are carried into the OTJ entry
The saved entry contributes to the OTJ total and OTJ arch
Evidence, camera, photo speed, video, menus, fade, tiles, layouts and course data are unchanged
summary: Evia v149 connects the existing post-evidence learning reflection to the real OTJ record.
